summary.name: Rclone UI
summary.one_liner: Rclone UI is an open-source desktop graphical interface for rclone, the command-line tool for syncing and mounting cloud storage such as S3 and Backblaze buckets.
keywords: graphical interface for command line tool
use_cases: Browse and manage files in S3 or Backblaze buckets from a desktop app
Mount cloud buckets as local drives
Use rclone without the command line
Sync files to cloud storage on Windows, Mac or Linux
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Rclone UI as a desktop GUI for rclone, written in Rust and React and released as open source on GitHub. It says it supports mounting buckets from S3, Backblaze, Cloudflare and other providers. It is described as cross-platform on Windows, Mac and Linux, with native integration. The page says the app uses the macOS hardened runtime and does not send analytics. Paid options are mentioned for unlocking deeper functionality and future features, with a mobile client listed as live and file commander and serving listed as planned.
notable: Open source, written in Rust and React
No analytics or phone-home in releases; uses macOS hardened runtime
Mounts S3, Backblaze, and Cloudflare buckets
Listed on the Mac App Store
caveats: Core app is described as forever free, but deeper functionality requires a paid lifetime license
File commander, serving, and other features are listed as future additions
Mobile client is referenced as live, but the page does not say which platform beyond the iOS listing
